title: Grenada IRD - Excise Tax
text:
Excise Tax

What is Excise Tax?

Excise tax is a tax imposed on the importation or manufacturing of an excisable good.




When must my return and/or payment reach Inland Revenue Division?

All returns must be received by Inland Revenue Division no later than the twentieth (20th) day of the following tax period. For example, if you are filing for the tax period in February, your return must reach the Inland Revenue Division no later than March 20th to avoid penalties for late filing and/or late payment.
